AVX-512 uint32 vector ops, loads, rotates, compares, and transpose macros.

# Purpose
This header defines the `wwu_t` API for 16-lane unsigned 32-bit integer SIMD values on AVX-512. It provides constructors, load and store helpers, lane access, arithmetic and bitwise operations, shifts and rotates, comparisons, masked selection, type conversions, byte swap, packing, sliding, unpacking, and transpose helpers for vector data. The code is narrow in scope and is intended to be included through `fd_avx512.h`, not used as a direct include. It acts as a low-level SIMD support header for other C++ code that needs fast vector integer operations.
